invite_space_invitation.context: Below the space name on the screen an invite link opens.

invite_code.context: Label of the row with the code of the invite.

invite_status.context: Label of the row that says whether the person already joined.

invite_already_joined.context: Status: the person already belongs to the space.

invite_ready.context: Status: the person can join the space.

invite_sign_in_required.context: Title of the note shown to people who are signed out.

invite_sign_in_message.text: Use your Saver account before joining this space.
invite_sign_in_message.context: Text of the note shown to people who are signed out.

invite_open_space.context: Button that opens a space the person already belongs to.

invite_opening.context: Shown on the button while the space is being opened.

invite_joining.context: Shown on the button while joining the space.

discord_connecting.context: Shown while the Discord account is being connected.

discord_connected.context: Title shown after the Discord account was connected.

discord_connected_message.text: You can now use the Saver bot with your account.
discord_connected_message.context: Text shown after the Discord account was connected.

discord_failed.context: Title shown when the Discord account could not be connected.

discord_error_reason.context: Shown when Discord refused the connection.

placeholders.%1$s: Reason given by Discord, usually in English

discord_error_no_code.text: Discord did not return a code.
discord_error_no_code.context: Shown when Discord returned without the code Saver needs.

discord_error_expired.text: This Discord link has expired. Please try again.
discord_error_expired.context: Shown when the link back from Discord is too old.

discord_error_sign_in.context: Shown when Discord is connected while signed out.

discord_error_connect.context: Shown when the server could not connect the Discord account.

notification_channel_reminders.context: Name of the notification category for reminders in the Android settings.

notification_channel_reminders_descripti.text: Reminders for your Saver tasks, bookmarks and habits.
notification_channel_reminders_descripti.context: Description of the reminder notification category in the Android settings.

notification_channel_silent.context: Name of the notification category for reminders without sound in the Android settings.

notification_channel_silent_description.text: Saver reminders that do not play a sound.
notification_channel_silent_description.context: Description of the silent reminder notification category in the Android settings.

notification_task_title.context: Title of a reminder notification for a task without a title.

notification_task_text.text: This task is due for your attention.
notification_task_text.context: Text of a reminder notification for a task.

notification_bookmark_title.context: Title of a reminder notification for a bookmark without a title.

notification_bookmark_text.text: You asked Saver to bring this bookmark back.
notification_bookmark_text.context: Text of a reminder notification for a bookmark.

notification_habit_title.context: Title of a reminder notification for a habit without a name.

notification_habit_text.text: Time to keep your streak going.
notification_habit_text.context: Text of a reminder notification for a habit.
